status: Closed — source-template corpus and installed-projection parity re-verified
area: A local git exclusion hid skill source files from version control with no governed signal
finding: The repository-local .git/info/exclude carried a bare templates/ rule under a 'Local governed-worktree exclusions' heading, alongside integrations/ and release/. templates/skills is the skill source of truth, not a generated artifact, so the rule was wrong in kind. Because gitignore rules only affect untracked paths, the 56 already-tracked files under templates/ kept committing normally and nothing ever looked broken; only newly added source files were affected, and those were affected absolutely. A new template could be written, validated, baked, and used locally while git status stayed silent, git check-ignore attributed it to .git/info/exclude:10, and a governed commit found nothing to deliver. .git/info/exclude is repo-local, is not itself version controlled, and is never reviewed, so a skill that works on one machine can be absent for every other collaborator with no artifact recording the difference. The corpus has a detector for exactly this — collectIgnoredSkillTemplatePaths reports ignoredSourceTemplatePaths — but it only matches exclude lines that contain 'templates/skills' and end in '.skill.md', so a directory-level rule, which is the form that actually occurred, is invisible to it and the field read [] throughout.
expectedBehavior: Source templates must be version controlled, and their being so must be a checked property rather than an assumption. State the general rule: any path that is a source of truth for the skill corpus must be tracked, and corpus completeness must be validated against tracked files, not merely against files present in the working tree. The exclusion detector must recognise directory-level and glob exclusions that cover the source root, not only exact file entries, and any untracked file under templates/skills must be reported as a hard finding by validate:skill-templates and by integration verify rather than surfacing only as an empty diff at commit time.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-14. git check-ignore -v templates/skills/atm-framework-quickfix.skill.md returned '.git/info/exclude:10:templates/', and git ls-files --error-unmatch confirmed the file had never been tracked; the earlier commit 5b400bbdc that added the quickfix route had added only the .agents copy. Three source paths were hidden by the rule: templates/skills/atm-framework-quickfix.skill.md, templates/skills/atm-diagnostic-loop.skill.md, and the seven reference files under templates/skills/atm-governance-router.files/references/. loadSkillCorpusSourceSnapshot('templates/skills') reported ignoredSourceTemplatePaths [] the entire time, because collectIgnoredSkillTemplatePaths in packages/integrations-core/src/compiler/skill-templates.ts:416 skips any exclude line not containing 'templates/skills' and not ending in '.skill.md'. Owner ruling on 2026-08-14 removed the single templates/ line and kept integrations/ and release/; the previously hidden quickfix template then committed through the normal governed temporary-claim route as 9d12aeb5276df38ef25feb5345a5bc7768732ef3 with no git add -f. The other two hidden paths were deliberately left untracked and out of that commit's scope.
followUp: Resolved by TASK-SKL-0040 delivery commit 639db50783b449ca14f00819d1edd7eb81dfe538. The sealed corpus now reports 25 tracked source templates and validate:skill-templates reports installedProjectionParity sync=25, approved-baseline=0, explicit-waiver=0, fail-closed=0. The integration-adapter validator and skill-corpus canary both pass after all six official adapter projections were refreshed. Future untracked or ignored source templates remain a hard corpus finding rather than an advisory-only omission. Formal closeout re-verification on 2026-09-02: `node --strip-types scripts/validate-skill-templates.ts` and `node --strip-types tests/cli/skill-corpus-canary-rewrite.test.ts` both passed, reporting no ignored or untracked source templates and installed-copy parity sync=25.
